newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits steady to higher before FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits steady to higher before FOMC.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were steady to higher in thin trade with most traders sidelined before the outcome of today's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) Meeting, dealers said on Tuesday.

"Rates were steady to slightly higher this morning on some position adjustments. Most people are waiting for the outcome of the FOMC Meeting for further clues to monetary policy," a local dealer said.
In short dates, Tuesday/Wednesday, Wednesday/Thursday and week-fixed were unchanged from Monday's common 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, respectively.
Among term rates, two-months rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-13/16 5-11/16 percent and four-months rose 1/16 point to 5-7/8 5-3/4 percent.
Six-months was unchanged from Monday's 6 5-7/8 percent and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/4 6-1/8 percent.
